_comment: The five mine biomes.
WHY THIS IS HAND-AUTHORED. The biome pages are almost entirely template
calls — floor ranges come from `{{BiomesQuick|1|floors no}}`, seal names from
`{{#vardefine:sealName|...}}` — so `action=raw` returns the machinery rather
than the values. Resolving that would mean implementing a chunk of the
MediaWiki parser function suite to extract five records. Everything below was
read out of Template:BiomesQuick and the five biome pages by hand, and each
field says where it came from.
FLOORS. From Template:BiomesQuick, which is the wiki's single source for
them: `floorsNum` is 1-19, 21-39, 41-59, 61-79, 81-99. The gaps are the seal
floors — 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 — which are story gates, not part of a biome.
Monsters do not spawn on floor 1 (Mines page, Trivia), and the Ancient Ruins
monster range is 81-89, 91-99 because floor 90 is a story floor.
SEALS. Each biome ends at a seal that must be broken to continue, named on
the biome page as `sealName`/`sealFloor`. The seal quest is what gates the
NEXT biome, so it is recorded on the biome it blocks entry to.
ORE. From each page's Mineables table. Both the base and Perfect variants are
listed because they are distinct items and gift lists distinguish them.
All biomes additionally have plain rocks dropping Stone, Peat, Sod and Clay
(Mines page, All Biomes) — recorded once as `common_drop_item_ids` rather
than repeated five times.
ARTIFACT SETS. Only sets specific to one biome are listed. Buried, Oopart,
Gems and Metals are linked from every biome page, and Ritual from every one
except the Upper Mines (the page's own `#ifeq` says so) — listing shared sets
would make all five biomes look identical and tell a player nothing. Each
biome has a set named after it; the Ancient Ruins additionally links to
Dragon, and that link appears on no other biome page, which is what makes it
specific rather than a guess.
NOT RECORDED. `monster_ids` is empty everywhere: the monster roster is in an
Encounters table whose drops come from `{{MonsterDrops|X}}`, another template
maze, and the monsters dataset does not exist yet. Empty plus a data gap, not
a half-filled guess. `fish_item_ids` is left to the build, which derives it
from items already located in the biome rather than repeating the list here.
